name: Android: Netrunner
summary: Asymmetric two-player cyberpunk card game where Corporation protects agendas with hidden ice and Runner hacks servers to steal them.
rules_text: Two players: Corporation and Runner, each with identity, deck, and credits. Corporation installs agendas, assets, upgrades in remote servers and ice in front of any server facedown and unrezzed. Runner installs hardware, programs, resources. On Corporation turn, gain credits and take 3 clicks to draw, gain credits, install, rez ice/assets/upgrades paying rez cost, advance and score agendas. On Runner turn, gain credits and take 4 clicks to draw, gain credits, install, play events, and make runs. During a run, Runner approaches ice one-by-one; Corporation may rez it; Runner must break subroutines with icebreakers whose strength matches. If all ice passed, Runner accesses server cards, stealing agendas for points, trashing others paying trash cost. First to 7 agenda points wins.
rating_reason: Android Netrunner is card game with hidden hands bluffing no board
